key.name: clock-font-family
key.description: Font family for the date/time labels. Empty string inherits the panel's default font.

key.name: clock-font-size
key.description: Font size in pixels for the date/time labels.

key.name: panel-height
key.description: Panel height in pixels. 0 uses the shell theme's default height.

key.name: window-color-blend-enabled
key.description: When a window's edge touches the top of the screen, the panel background samples and matches its color there instead of using the default background.

key.name: liquid-glass-intensity
key.description: How translucent the Control Center, Notification Center, and notification banners are. 100 is full glass (the original translucent look); 0 is fully solid/opaque (white in light mode, dark in dark mode), interpolated linearly in between. Does not affect the dock.

key.name: auto-hide-in-fullscreen
key.summary: Auto-hide the menu bar in full screen
key.description: When true, the panel slides up out of view while any window on the primary monitor is full screen, and slides back down once nothing is. When false, the panel always stays shown regardless of full screen state.

key.name: clock-show-date
key.summary: Show the date next to the clock

key.name: battery-show-percentage
key.summary: Show the battery percentage next to its icon
